prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A single, elegant bottle of skincare product stands upright on a smooth, white surface, positioned slightly off-center against a warm beige background. The bottle is a soft, pastel blue with a white pump dispenser and minimalist black text, featuring the brand name "sisley" and product details in a refined, modern font. Dramatic, angled sunlight streams in from the upper right, casting a sharp, geometric shadow across the background and partially illuminating the bottle, creating a striking contrast between light and shadow. The overall composition is clean and uncluttered, with a strong sense of negative space and a focus on simplicity and sophistication. The color palette is muted and harmonious, dominated by soft blues, warm beige, and crisp white, evoking a serene, high-end, editorial aesthetic. The lighting is natural and directional, emphasizing the product’s contours and lending the scene a cinematic, almost architectural quality. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the bottle in sharp focus while subtly blurring the background, drawing all attention to the product as the hero of the image.
